description: Traffic Counters is a dataset listed in Open Data Bristol, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Bristol City Council. Locations and meta data for traffic counters. These are induction loops in the road that detect the passing vehicles but don't discriminate between vehicle types. Coverage: Bristol. The portal files it under Transport & Streets. Its keywords are Traffic Data, transport, traffic. The portal shows 503 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence V 3.0 (http://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-bristol-gov-uk-portal.
